text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for letting me rest yesterday.
Thanks to that, I was able to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, even during my time off, I never neglected my prayers,
elevating my saintly powers all the while."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Carrying out my daily routine, maintaining a regular rhythm, and living healthy days...
This, too, is how a saint ought to conduct herself.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I want to show you the strength I've cultivated through my daily prayers, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Red Desire was able
to get plenty of rest.
